name: Oakhaven Sewers
description: A damp sewer system under the town square. Infested with easy creatures.
visualTheme: Damp stone brick walls, dripping pipes, and green sludge channels.

history.currentConflicts: Mutated slimes threaten Oakhaven's clean water supply.
